name: Beam Button
hint: Watch the beam run a lap and park. Hover to spin it, Tab to it for one lap.
description: A landing-page CTA with a light travelling around its border and a soft glow. The beam runs a lap when the button first comes into view, then parks and stays lit; it spins while hovered, takes one lap on keyboard focus and coasts back to rest when you leave, so nothing moves on its own for 5 seconds or more. The trailing arrow nudges on hover. Reduced motion or disabled keeps the beam parked.
usage: Use for the single most important action in a hero or pricing section. One per page; it stops being special if repeated. Pass the text as `label` or `children` and the handler as `onClick(event)`; blank shows the neutral "Get started". If the click starts async work, set `loading` until it ends: a spinner replaces the arrow and clicks are ignored. It is a real <button> (`type`, `disabled`, `form`, aria-* and data-* go to it) and the ref is that button. The intro run is capped below 5 seconds; set laps to 0 to keep the beam parked until hover.

dataProps.description: Button text. Blank shows the neutral "Get started" (the sample "Start building" with `demo`). `children` wins over it.
Button content as a node, instead of `label`. It sits inline like text; wrap an icon and text in your own inline-flex span to space them.
(event) => void when pressed. Not called while `loading` or `disabled`.
The native button type. Use "submit" inside a <form>.
You own it: set it while the action's async work runs. The arrow becomes a spinner (a spinner after the text when `arrow` is off), aria-busy is set and clicks are ignored; the width does not change.
Native disabled: not focusable or clickable, dimmed, and the beam stays parked.
Shows the sample label "Start building" when `label` is blank. For the gallery; off by default.
Other attributes (id, name, value, form, aria-*, data-*, event handlers) go to the <button>; className and style go to the wrapper span.
The <button>: focus it or measure it.
